descriptions.aardant: An innocuous application of Fusion technology.
descriptions.allies_address: Room 31, Block 2, Omnichannel Tower, Cotton Town\n\nThere's a kiss mark next to the address
descriptions.alpha_seep: Thick, mucosal secretion harvested from the scent glands of apex predators at the peak of their territorial cycle.
descriptions.ancient_egg: A peculiar egg. If you plant it, maybe it will hatch.
descriptions.antidote_grapes: Pop a few of these and you'll laugh in the face of poison! Delicious and detoxifying all in one bite.
descriptions.app_banking: Access your funds here whenever you're in a town.
descriptions.app_contacts: Call your friends and battle the people of your choice.
descriptions.app_map: Use this on your phone to see where you are.
descriptions.app_radio: Tune in to local broadcasts, quest updates, and ambient chatter from across the region.
descriptions.app_renaming: Give your Tuxemon a fresh identity with a new name—make it truly yours!
descriptions.app_tuxepedia: Keep track of information about Tuxemon here, and share it with the world.
descriptions.archeologist_sensor: Detects energy signatures in rare, mysterious artifacts.
descriptions.beastmoss: Thick moss found clinging to ancient creatures and sacred stones. Chewy, earthy, and perfect in flakey wraps or hearty pies.
descriptions.bio_sample: Organic particles from tuxemon habitats; reactive and unstable.
descriptions.bite_of_despair: Its scent hits first. Then the flavor finishes the job mercilessly.
descriptions.bivouac: Rest as if you were at a proper healing center. Consumed on use.
descriptions.book_wishes: The Achievement Maniac's list of achievements for you to attempt.
descriptions.boost_armour: For the rest of the combat, increase Armor by two stages.
descriptions.boost_dodge: For the rest of the combat, increase Dodge by two stages.
descriptions.boost_melee: For the rest of the combat, increase Melee by two stages.
descriptions.boost_ranged: For the rest of the combat, increase Ranged by two stages.
descriptions.boost_speed: For the rest of the combat, increase Speed by two stages.
descriptions.booster_tech: An open source technology that allows to morph tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.buzz_resonator: Detects insect-like tuxemon vibrations and hive signals.
descriptions.cheesecake: Soft moo bloom cake with glowfat swirl. Creamy and luxurious with a mellow sparkle.
descriptions.cosmic_berry: It changes monster type to Cosmic.
descriptions.crackle_salt: Sparkling minerals mined in echoing caves. Adds bite and shimmer to savory recipes, and sometimes pops mid-bite!
descriptions.cream_puffs: Sweetroot puffs filled with enchanted cream. Light, airy, and wickedly indulgent.
descriptions.crepes: Thin meal dust crepes wrapped around shimmer filling. Graceful, sweet, and just a little peppery.
descriptions.croissants: Buttery suncrust croissants with zesty dust. Crisp, golden, and lightly electrified.
descriptions.cure_festering: Rinse out the wound and you'll be right.
descriptions.cureall: Heals your tuxemon to full health and removes any conditions.
descriptions.die: Confused? Roll the die and do whatever it says!
descriptions.dojo_pass: Admit one to the Dojo of the Elements.
descriptions.dread_omelette: It defies the laws of texture and taste. Even your utensils rebel.
descriptions.drone: Switch out one tuxemon on your team for one in storage.
descriptions.dusty_datalog: A digital book of fragmented text and audio logs.
descriptions.earth_berry: It changes monster type to Earth.
descriptions.earth_booster: It allows to morph an Earth type tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.earthmover_key: Could come in handy if there's a giant earthmover blocking the path.
descriptions.echo_core: Contains faint sound loops and vibrations from lost memories.
descriptions.elixir_of_life: Holding this item keeps a monster in juvenile form indefinitely, increasing its Armor and Dodge stats.
descriptions.encoded_chip: A worn data chip etched with arcane symbols and non-standard code.
descriptions.feather: Tickle your assailant and force them to relinquish their grip!
descriptions.field_greens: Wild leaves that shift color with the wind. Bright, peppery, and often eaten fresh—or warmed just enough to curl.
descriptions.field_transcriber: Records wild discoveries and turns them into lore entries.
descriptions.fire_berry: It changes monster type to Fire.
descriptions.fire_booster: It allows to morph a Fire type tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.flamehorn_shank: Thick slices harvested from flamehorn flora—giant, non-sentient fireplants cultivated for seared cuts. Bold, charred, and packed with bite.
descriptions.flickering_drive: A storage device showing strange data in an unreadable language.
descriptions.flintstone: A flaky stone used to make stone tools and start fires. Not at the same time.
descriptions.flute: Play a soothing tune and stay sharp! With this flute, nodding off and dozing are no match for you.
descriptions.friendship_scroll: It allows to deepen your relationship with the monsters.
descriptions.frost_berry: It changes monster type to Frost.
descriptions.glowfat: Rendered oil from luminous vines or docile beastbloom. Silky texture with a buttery aroma—used for cooking or glazing.
descriptions.good_penny: Trainer doubles their winnings from any monster the holder helped defeat.
descriptions.greenwash_badge: Tuxemon purchased from Greenwash require this badge to morph.
descriptions.hash: Warm hash of root veggies and enchanted herbs. Earthy comfort with a peppery kick.
descriptions.hatchet: Cut down pesky logs with the Hatchet.
descriptions.heart_biscuit: A biscuit that splits in equal halves. It warms the hearts of those who share it.
descriptions.heroic_berry: It changes monster type to Heroic.
descriptions.honey_cake: Moist sweetroot cake infused with shimmer dust. Sweet, spicy, and full of bounce.
descriptions.horseshoe: On the wrong foot? Put a horseshoe on it!
descriptions.inferno_custard: Too hot to eat. Too cursed to ignore. The bowl crackles with regret.
descriptions.latent_relic: Seems inert until exposed to lore analyzers.
descriptions.lightning_berry: It changes monster type to Lightning.
descriptions.lima_pie: A tasty cake baked from lima berries.
descriptions.lucky_bamboo: Technically, it's not bamboo at all. Nor is it particularly lucky. But it makes a nice indoor plant.
descriptions.mashed_potatoes: Soft root mash with crackle salt and moo bloom cream. Comforting with a fizzy edge.
descriptions.meal_dust: A fine blend of skyfield grains crushed under moonlight. Flexible, lightweight, and essential to anything baked, folded, or fried.
descriptions.meatballs: Crumbled stonefruit bulb balls in zestsap glaze. Hearty, tangy, and magically satisfying.
descriptions.metal_berry: It changes monster type to Metal.
descriptions.metal_booster: It allows to morph a Metal type tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.miaow_milk: Cats love the taste of Miaow Milk™!
descriptions.mille_feuille: Layered pastry made with mistflour and moo bloom cream. Rich, delicate, and stacked with sweetness.
descriptions.mistflour_eggs: Mysterious eggs laid by cloud roosting avians. Soft-shelled and full of magical air, they fluff and bind dishes like a dream.
descriptions.mm_earth: Learn the particular Earth type technique in this MM. Then it is consumed.
descriptions.mm_fire: Learn the particular Fire type technique in this MM. Then it is consumed.
descriptions.mm_metal: Learn the particular Metal type technique in this MM. Then it is consumed.
descriptions.mm_water: Learn the particular Water type technique in this MM. Then it is consumed.
descriptions.mm_wood: Learn the particular Wood type technique in this MM. Then it is consumed.
descriptions.moo_bloom: Milky nectar tapped from docile meadow beasts. Smooth and comforting with notes of honeygrass and sugarstem.
descriptions.mystery_analyzer: A chunky scanner that beeps joyfully when decoding artifacts.
descriptions.nimrod_badge: Tuxemon purchased from Nimrod require this badge to morph.
descriptions.normal_berry: It changes monster type to Normal.
descriptions.nu_phone: You can do a lot with this, e.g. phone home.
descriptions.omnichannel_badge: Tuxemon purchased from Omnichannel require this badge to morph.
descriptions.open_hand: Attacks made by a tuxemon holding this item will never reduce a foe below 1 HP.
descriptions.ox_stick: An inspiring weapon for an ancient tuxemon.
descriptions.p_monsters_eyes: Painting 'Monsters' Eyes Meet', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.
descriptions.p_starry_night: Painting 'Starry, Starry, Starry Night', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.
descriptions.p_trepidation: Painting 'Trepidation', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.
descriptions.pancakes: Fluffy sky-grain cakes topped with shimmer zest. Soft, warm, and joyfully bright.
descriptions.pastry: Flaky pastry filled with a spicy sweetroot swirl. Buttery folds with a firecracker heart.
descriptions.peace_lily: A hardy indoor plant for someone special.
descriptions.petrified_dung: It looks like, well, poo ... but it's hard as stone.
descriptions.phyllo: Flaky wrap filled with tangy beastmoss. Delicate layers with a bold, earthy center.
descriptions.pie: Golden pie crust filled with beastmoss stew. Hearty, flaky, and deeply savory.
descriptions.pita: Dry crispbread with a zesty spice dust spread. Simple, snappy, and full of flavor.
descriptions.pollen_decoder: Reads biological residue and pollen from nature-bound tuxemon.
descriptions.potato_casserole: Sweetroot and mistflour layers baked in zestsap. Warm and citrusy with a soft bite.
descriptions.potato_fries: Sweetroot fries with magical salt blend. Crunchy, glowing, and surprisingly feisty.
descriptions.pretzels: Twisted field grain bites with starpepper hints. Salty, chewy, and playfully spicy.
descriptions.pudding: Creamy sweetroot pudding with a tangy glow. Smooth and citrusy with a gentle shimmer.
descriptions.pyramidion: A golden triangle that hums with celestial power.
descriptions.raise_armour: Learn the hardness of the diamond. Train Armor.
descriptions.raise_dodge: Learn the iridescence of the opal. Train Dodge.
descriptions.raise_hp: Learn the bulk and abundance of quartz. Train HP.
descriptions.raise_melee: Learn the anger of the ruby. Train Melee.
descriptions.raise_ranged: Learn the aim of the emerald. Train Ranged.
descriptions.raise_speed: Learn the reflexes of the spinel. Train Speed.
descriptions.refreshing_slice: Take a juicy bite and feel the fatigue melt away. Exhaustion doesn't stand a chance against this revitalizing treat!
descriptions.reg_papers: A packet of registration papers for The Trial
descriptions.repellent: Deter wild encounters with this stinky spray.
descriptions.researcher_stylus: Interfaces with digital and ancient data carriers.
descriptions.restoration: Remove any condition currently affecting the target.
descriptions.revive: Revives knocked out Tuxemon and restores half HP.
descriptions.rhincus_fossil: It looks like the skull of a toothed bird, but it's hard as stone.
descriptions.root_beast_bark: Strips of hardened plant flesh shaped like ribs. Smoky and fibrous with a primal umami—seasoned like a carnivore's dream, but plant-based.
descriptions.rub_chicken: Sky feather cutlets rubbed in starpepper mix. Light, crispy, and boldly seasoned.
descriptions.rub_pork_chops: Root beast bark slices coated in crackle dust. Smoky, spicy, and fierce—seasoned like primal meat, but purely plant-powered.
descriptions.rub_ribs: Stonefruit bulb ribs coated in crackle spices. Meaty texture and satisfying pop.
descriptions.rub_steak: Flamehorn-style roast rubbed with spice crystals. Bold, seared, and humming with heat.
descriptions.scoop_badge: Tuxemon purchased from Scoop require this badge to morph.
descriptions.sea_girdle: A string of baubles, soft and slimy like kelp.
descriptions.shadow_berry: It changes monster type to Shadow.
descriptions.shaft_badge: Tuxemon purchased from Shaft require this badge to morph.
descriptions.shammer_fossil: It looks like the skull of an ancient dog, but it's hard as stone.
descriptions.shell_tacos: Field wrap tacos with zestroot fillings and moo bloom sauce. Fresh, springy, and packed with zip.
descriptions.signal_node: Mini transmitter relaying fractured messages from unknown sources.
descriptions.sky_berry: It changes monster type to Sky.
descriptions.sky_feather: Plucked from the molting of breezebirds after migration. Delicate, light, and a crisp favorite for peppy platings.
descriptions.souffle: Airy glowfat soufflé puffed with zestsap. Light, tangy, and dreamlike on the tongue.
descriptions.spice_dust: Crushed crystals infused with latent fire and zingfruit essence. Flickers on the tongue and wakes up any dish with a dazzling spark.
descriptions.spyder_pass: This should let you in to places only Spyder conspirators are meant to go.
descriptions.starlight_lens: Captures celestial patterns linked to cosmic tuxemon.
descriptions.starpepper: Tiny glowing berries that ripen only under starlight. Fiery but sweet, they burn with a warmth that tickles rather than scorches.
descriptions.stonefruit_bulbs: Hearty root-plants from volcanic valleys. Firm like meat, flavorful like mushroom, and deeply satisfying.
descriptions.stovepipe: A long iron pipe. Handling it leaves your hands sooty and ashen.
descriptions.suncrust_butter: Golden-rich cream pressed from sun-petal blooms. Warm, smooth, and faintly herbal—used to soften, shine, and enrich any dish.
descriptions.surfboard: From your Mom. It lets you travel faster.
descriptions.sweet_sand: In parts of the world, people clean themselves with this fragrant, sudsy sand.
descriptions.sweetroot: Glowing tubers harvested from whispering forest hollows. Sweet and mellow with a hint of citrus zing—ideal for desserts or tangy toppings.
descriptions.tachyon_collector: Captures and measures the presence of tachyons emitted by time manipulation.
descriptions.tectonic_drill: A big click-clack machine used to drill into the earth.
descriptions.thunderstone: An old stone relic, now carried about for good luck.

descriptions.toy_bear: Substitute this toy bear for yourself when your life energy is being sapped!
descriptions.tuxeball_ancient: This Tuxeball was made a long time ago and is capable of catching any Tuxemon without fail.
descriptions.tuxeball_candy: Captures Tuxemon and increases its level by one upon capture.
descriptions.tuxeball_crusher: This Tuxeball breaks through defenses and increases the catch rate the higher the opposing Tuxemon's defense is. It will fail to catch if a protective condition is in place.
descriptions.tuxeball_diurnal: Captures more easily during daytime, but its effectiveness is significantly reduced during the night.
descriptions.tuxeball_earth: Captures more easily an Earth Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_female: Captures more easily a Female Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_fire: Captures more easily a Fire Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_gambler: This tuxeball is known for its unpredictable nature. Its catch rate fluctuates wildly, with the chance of capturing a tuxemon ranging from extremely low to exceptionally high.
descriptions.tuxeball_grand: Offers an even higher capture rate than the Lavish Tuxeball.
descriptions.tuxeball_hardened: Captures Tuxemon and it doesn't break when it fails.
descriptions.tuxeball_hearty: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to hearty.
descriptions.tuxeball_lavish: Boasts a significantly higher capture rate than the Noble Tuxeball.
descriptions.tuxeball_majestic: The ultimate choice for catching even the most elusive tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_male: Captures more easily a Male Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_metal: Captures more easily a Metal Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_neuter: Captures more easily a Neuter Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_noble: A moderate upgrade to the standard Tuxeball.
descriptions.tuxeball_nocturnal: Captures more easily during nighttime, but its effectiveness is significantly reduced during the day.
descriptions.tuxeball_omni: This odd Tuxeball increases the chance of succeeding if the opposing Tuxemon is the same type as yours, but has a decreased chance if they are different types.
descriptions.tuxeball_park: The official Park capture device. It only works inside the Park.
descriptions.tuxeball_peppy: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to peppy.
descriptions.tuxeball_refined: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to refined.
descriptions.tuxeball_salty: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to salty.
descriptions.tuxeball_water: Captures more easily a Water Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_wood: Captures more easily a Wood Tuxemon.
descriptions.tuxeball_xero: This odd Tuxeball increases the chance of succeeding if the opposing Tuxemon is a different type than yours, but has a decreased chance if they are the same type.
descriptions.tuxeball_zesty: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to zesty.
descriptions.unknown_object: Unknown origin and use. Must be identified before being applied.
descriptions.venom_berry: It changes monster type to Venom.
descriptions.water_berry: It changes monster type to Water.
descriptions.water_booster: It allows to morph a Water type tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.whispersoup: The ladle trembles as you serve. No one speaks of what happened next.
descriptions.wings: Crispy flying-beast style bites with magical heat. Bold, sizzling, and bite-sized bravery.
descriptions.wood_berry: It changes monster type to Wood.
descriptions.wood_booster: It allows to morph a Wood type tuxemon into a different form.
descriptions.xp_feeder: A tuxemon that holds this item receives half of all XP gained by your party, regardless of whether it participated in battle.\n The remainder of the XP is split between monsters that did participate.
descriptions.xp_transmitter: When this item is in your possession, all monsters that did not participate in defeating a monster get half of the XP. The remainder goes to the monsters that did participate.
descriptions.zestroot_wraps: Flexible shoots used as edible wrappers. Springy and infused with latent spice—favored in soft, foldable dishes.
descriptions.zestsap: Electrified syrup drawn from zingfruit trees. Sharp, citrus-like and wonderfully alive on the tongue—used to wake up sleepy flavors.
